name: Himekawa Fuuka
source:
Metis: <Aegis> (Shield)

Class president of 2A and classmate of [url=/c31817]Keiji[/url]. She is popular at Suminoe next to [url=/c12469]Kotoha[/url], her roommate and best friend. 
A hardworker and take everything with earnestness. Her grade is one of the highest in the school. Furthermore, her Metis <Aegis> is dubbed as "the absoulute shield" and has the highest power level in history of Suminoe Gakuen. Despite all that, she is clueless when it comes to love. 
A perfect girl no matter how you look at it. However, it seems that there is more to her than meets the eye...
